y1: When some people helped the poor, they blew trumpets and bragged. They wanted people to praise them.
y2: Jesus said: “When you give charity, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing. Your Father who sees in secret will reward you.”
y4: “When you pray, do not pray on the street corners to be seen by people. Go into your room, close the door, and pray.”
y5: “God does not hear you just because you use many words. Your Father knows what you need before you ask Him.”
y7: Jesus taught how to pray. This is called the Lord's Prayer.
y8: “Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us today our daily bread. Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.”
y10: “If you forgive people their trespasses, your Heavenly Father will also forgive you.”
y11: When you fast, wash your face and be cheerful. We show this to God, not to people.
verse: “Our Father in heaven! May your name be kept holy.”
prayer: Our Father in heaven, thank You for calling me Your child and teaching me how to pray. Help me to live only for You, not to be seen by people. Help me to forgive my friend who did wrong to me. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: charity. Giving what is needed to poor people and those in trouble. Give charity in secret.
d1: room. A small and quiet room in the house. Go into your room, close the door, and pray.
d2: the Lord's Prayer. The prayer that Jesus Himself taught. We read the Lord's Prayer together in worship.
d3: daily bread. The food we need to live today. Give us today our daily bread.
d4: forgive. Accepting someone who did wrong to us without punishing them. God forgives our sins.
d5: fast. Not eating food for a while to focus on God. Keep your face cheerful even when you fast.
